findings.title: GET /api/v1/products: live OpenAPI 401 schema declares a product array but returns an error object
findings.expected: The live OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, info.version 1.0, declares responses.401.content["*/*"].schema.type=array with ProductDto items. Documentation should describe the actual authentication error; source ErrorResponseDefinition emits an object containing message.
findings.actual: Two anonymous GETs returned HTTP 401 application/json;charset=UTF-8 with {"message":"Unauthorized"}; two independently fetched live specs both declare an array.
findings.impact: The documented 401 JSON type contradicts the observable response, so schema-based contract validation fails. Generated-client error handling impact is plausible but untested. Authentication itself correctly denied access.

risks.area: Authenticated cart ownership and role boundaries
risks.reason: No authorized identities were used; anonymous 401 checks cannot establish ownership isolation or admin restrictions. CartController derives username from authenticated principal in supplied snapshot.
risks.next_probe: In an authorized disposable environment, compare two users with distinct carts and check client/admin role restrictions using owned fixtures.

risks.reason: Live cart 401 response references CartDto, while observed body is a message error. CartDto has no required fields and permits additional properties, so no strict JSON-schema failure is demonstrated.
risks.next_probe: Clarify intended error DTO, then add focused generated-contract assertions for protected operations.

risks.reason: Session excluded sign-in, reset, account creation, stored credentials, mutations, and faults; valid/expired/revoked token behavior untested.
risks.next_probe: Use an explicitly authorized disposable account to examine expiry, logout/revocation, refresh, and failed-login behavior without external email delivery.
